Use coverage.gaps from representative captures to select one broadly shared opaque callback/task domain; source-audit and expose its captured state, ordering, and deadlines, while retaining explicit gaps for unknown closures. Preserve the existing not-established behavior and validate one representative closure and one incomplete case.

basis.evidence: Phase capture records named providers and concrete gaps; coverage is complete only when no gaps remain.

One provisional Stellar periodic result exists; shared private clocks, equipment/events/reactions/tasks, shield/stamina callbacks and stochastic steady state remain bounded or open.
Energy startup and observation-window UI are delivered; general closure and random steady state remain incomplete.
Deterministic convergence requires phase-aligned relevant state; stochastic runs require a disclosed warmup/distribution policy.

findings.scope: Do not add energy widgets or another character-scoped test batch. Seed capture alone does not establish stochastic convergence.

findings.recommendation: Run the existing data-discovery workflow once with authorized repository Actions access, inspect and retain its uploaded artifact and review receipt, then reconcile the actual outcome into status/evidence. Keep discovery separate from release identity and candidate promotion. Create a preview only if an immutable source-to-release mapping is established.

basis.evidence: Scheduled/manual workflow already discovers sources, captures an isolated candidate, assembles a read-only receipt, uploads artifacts, and reports failures.
Discovery fingerprints source bytes; review assembles discovery, candidate, and failure history without automatically updating project status.
Current observed provider/community evidence remains labeled 7.1; focused official search did not confirm a 7.2 detail, and absence is not proof.
Remote workflow execution and a verified 7.2 V1 mapping remain outstanding.
Release identity, verification coverage, and isolated immutable preview snapshots are separate requirements.

findings.blockers: Executing the remote workflow requires repository Actions access. Release mapping, complete version evidence, and redistribution rights require external evidence; these are not missing pipeline features. Do not promote from discovery alone.
